source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Sub-Mariner (archived 23 June 2017)

powerOrigins.detail: Half Atlantean (Homo mermanus): his strength, toughness and water breathing come from that heritage, at levels beyond any other Atlantean.
Also a mutant, often called Marvel's first; his ankle wings and flight cannot be explained by either his human or Atlantean side.

abilities.name: Superhuman strength
abilities.detail: Stronger than any other Atlantean: rated Class 100 when wet and about Class 85 on land, fading the longer he stays dry.

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.detail: Small wings on his ankles let him fly faster than military aircraft while carrying heavy loads.

abilities.name: Amphibious body
abilities.detail: Breathes underwater through gills and on land without aid, sees through murky depths and shrugs off freezing cold.

abilities.name: Superhuman durability
abilities.detail: Withstands high-calibre bullets, deep-sea pressure, temperature extremes and powerful energy blasts.

abilities.name: Swimming speed
abilities.detail: Has swum at over 300 knots, about 345 mph, far beyond the 60 mph of ordinary Atlanteans.

abilities.name: Aquatic telepathy
abilities.detail: Mentally talks to most sea life and can persuade it to obey; he can also give mental orders to Atlanteans.

abilities.name: Warrior king
abilities.detail: Long life and many wars made him an expert fighter, swordsman and marksman, as well as a capable ruler and tactician.

feats.text: Dragged Luke Cage into a river and beat him there, knocked out She-Hulk, then went toe to toe with the Thing.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Uncanny X-Men Vol 2 12

feats.text: Fought the Silver Surfer, took a point-blank blast and knocked him down, then won him over to stop a weather-control machine.
Diving in from flight, he knocked out the colossal Deviant mutate Gigantus with a single punch.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Journey Into Mystery Vol 4 649

feats.text: Flew after an escaping helicopter, grabbed its tail, spun it round and slammed it into the sea.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever

feats.text: Leading the flood on Birnin Zana, he blocked M'Baku's club bare-handed, broke it, punched him away, then cut down Wakandan aircraft in flight.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever

feats.text: Took a full-power Ironheart blast to the chest without visible harm.
